subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should signed message-action context plus plugin-facing native-conversation and invocation-origin fields become the permanent host-to-plugin authorization contract?
rationale: This choice defines which runtime facts external plugins and operator clients may trust before provider access and how legacy callers fail closed; code review cannot choose that permanent security and API boundary.

options.title: Adopt composed contract
options.body: Keep the signed operation-local authority and public plugin context after exact-head compatibility and live proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow public surface
options.body: Keep authority host-internal and adapt bundled channel owners without exposing permanent plugin fields.

options.title: Split for redesign
options.body: Land provider-local read gates separately while redesigning the cross-runtime trust contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt composed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the signed operation-local authority and public plugin context after exact-head compatibility and live proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the central dispatcher and Codex context paths, making this the best available owner for the cross-runtime contract decision.
